label: Paper puppets
description: Cut-paper puppets with jointed limbs and visible split pins, on painted paper backdrops layered like a toy theatre. Textured card, soft side light, handmade.
image: a cut-paper puppet theatre: figures cut from textured coloured card with jointed limbs held by small brass split pins, flat painted-paper backdrops and layered paper flats one behind another, visible paper grain and hand-cut edges, a small soft shadow under each layer, handmade and slightly naive
light: a warm soft side light across the stage, gentle shadows between the paper layers
camera: in front of the stage: slow pans along it and gentle push-ins
motion: cut-out puppet animation: stiff jointed limbs swinging on their pins, figures sliding and bobbing across the stage, stepped handmade timing
avoid: photorealism, 3D render, smooth CGI motion, glossy surfaces
